states.label: Condensation

states.label: Precipitation

states.why: Droplet mass exceeds cloud support capacity.

states.label: Collection
states.sentence: Water flows across terrain into rivers and returns to oceans.
states.why: Gravity pulls surface water toward base level elevations.
